reviews.title: Great for a while
reviews.text: I used this app for a couple months and at first it was great. It edited the raw photos from my Canon and turned them into beautiful JPGs all for free. But suddenly out the blue, the app just started crashing. It would crash when making edits and I wouldn’t even be able to export my photos. I contacted support around 4 month ago, they said they were working on it but nothing has changed. It could be because I currently have an older iPhone 13 but it seemed like a more global platform when looking online for answers. FIX YOUR APP PLEASE!!

reviews.title: Used to be the Gold Standard 5-Star App; Now Unusable
reviews.text: Since December, the app's histogram has been utterly broken. Any modification - literally ANY - caused the histogram to display a clipping alert. LITERALLY. ANY. This caused me to wonder if there was an actual error in editing, or just the app bugging out. Either way, it made me lose confidence in even bothering editing photos using the app, which is heartbreaking. I haven't been able to edit photos with full confidence, and will probably cancel my subscription since the bug still exists. I've tried holding out for a fix, but it doesn't seem like it's a priority, even though I'm sure I can't be the only one experiencing this major bug. Not sure how others are tolerating it.

reviews.title: Review from Disappointed A Legacy User/Longtime Supporter
reviews.text: 2010 or 2011 I started using this app. I purchased it at the time for $10. Wrote a great review and gave five stars and recommended it to everyone I knew. Then it was sold and came a the "Legacy User" title and "perks". Fast forward to the present not only did the "perks" started to fade away but I went from paying yearly for the IOS  and MacOS apps. Now all of my previous presets that I created GONE with endless back and forth with their Support Team. To now *new* subscription prices of $10 a month and $40 yearly. Putting me a "Legacy User" back to square 1... a new Member!!! Well DarkRoom you will go back to 1 STAR rating and I will say goodbye to you.

reviews.title: Desktop Version
reviews.text: I find the software is very glitchy, photographs disappear when clicked on and you have to restart the software to see them again. When applying changes, they don’t show immediately and you have to wait, impatiently, in my case, while the software decides to do anything. And this morning it won’t open at all. All in all, a big waste of money and not something I would recommend anyone to buy. I’ve given it two starts as when it does work, it’s great but for me, the untrustworthy workflow is a deal breaker.

reviews.title: Simply unusable in is current state
reviews.text:
I had this app (and have been paying)for over a year now and In the beginning, prior to adding video editing features things ran smoothly for the most part. Crashes here and there and some limited functionality compared to other offerings from adobe and photomator. But as they have added features the bugs have been constant. 
I am simply trying to edit my raw photos and export then back to the photo app. While editing I often have crashes (I figure Ok I have amini 6 maybe it's slow or something, I give it a little latitude for some errors) but I CAN NOT EXPORT PHOTOS ANYMORE. This defeats the entire purpose of this app.I paid for the year and now am sick with an app that won't let me do is basic functions.
Avoid until there are consistent positive reviews again and bugs have been delt with. This app is simply unusable in is current state

reviews.title: App Has Changed
reviews.text:
About 7 years ago I switched to IOS photo editing. There was no photoshop for IOS so I went with Affinity Photo. Darkroom and Affinity Photo were the perfect match. With the new version of Darkroom, it doesn’t recognize TIFF’s from Affinity Photo and Darkroom cuts my images in half and switches the halves when converting from TIFF to JPEG. I don’t understand how an almost perfect app has changed so much for the worse.

Update: Tried VSCO for two weeks and disliked it a lot and came back to Darkroom. There is still an issue of Darkroom being able to upload TIFF’s from Affinity Photo 2. Don’t know if this is an issue on Affinity Photo’s end or Darkroom’s end. These two programs used to work so very well together!
